title: Final: Core and Standard
cards/0/task: One target that all four hosts load with no caveats.
cards/1/task: All four hosts, but the .NET 10 app must get a net10.0 build and Unity must get netstandard2.1. Three targets at most.
cards/2/q: Why does .NET Standard 2.1 work in Unity and .NET 10 but not in .NET Framework?
cards/2/options/0: Framework stopped at 2.0: the new APIs need runtime changes, and Framework is frozen
cards/2/options/1: Unity and .NET 10 are the same runtime
cards/2/explain: Unity (Mono) and .NET 10 (CoreCLR) are different runtimes, but both implement 2.1.
cards/3/q: What came with .NET Core? Select all that apply.
cards/3/explain: AppDomain is exactly what was left behind.
cards/4/q: Build a library for .NET 8 and for Framework
cards/5/q: Match each year to what happened
cards/6/q: Targets are net48 and netstandard2.0. Which build does Revit 2024 take?
cards/6/options/0: net48, since it is closer to Framework
cards/7/q: What is .NET Standard, in one word?
cards/7/explain: It is a list of APIs. An actual runtime executes the code.
